rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for a sheet used on a bed.

example.english: The sheet is dirty, so we need to change it.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 cong4 daan1 wu1 zou1 laa3 jiu3 wun6 laa1

rows.note: Use this for one sheet or piece of ordinary paper, rather than for a bed covering or solid material.

example.english: Give me one sheet of paper; I want to write down the phone number.
example.traditional: 畀我一張紙，我想寫低個電話。
example.jyutping: bei2 ngo5 jat1 zoeng1 zi2 ngo5 soeng2 se2 dai1 go3 din6 waa2

rows.note: Use this for a thin, flat solid piece such as a sheet of glass or metal.

example.english: This metal sheet bends easily, so do not press it too hard.
example.traditional: 呢塊金屬薄片好容易彎，唔好大力按。
example.jyutping: nei1 faai3 gam1 suk6 bok6 pin3 hou2 jung4 ji6 waan1 m4 hou2 daai6 lik6 on3

rows.note: Use this construction when a sheet is a layer of something, and for a material spread across a surface, such as ice or mud.

example.english: A sheet of ice has formed on the ground, so it is really slippery.
example.traditional: 地面結咗一層冰，好滑呀。
example.jyutping: dei6 min6 git3 zo2 jat1 cang4 bing1 hou2 waat6 aa3
